With eps=1/a and y=eps*Y, stationary equation reduces to G=Y-eta-2eta*eps*Y+eps*(1+eps*Y)*(eps^2*Y^2-nu^2)=0. G(0,eta)=0 and dG/dY=1, so IFT gives Y=eta+(2eta^2+nu^2)*eps+O(eps^2). An independent symbolic expansion of b then yields 1-b=2eta/a+nu^2/a^2+O(a^-3). The Coulomb phase rho-eta*log(2rho)-L*pi/2+sigma and 2024 McMahon zeros imply x_n=pi*n+eta*log n+O(1). Given the source-minimum a_n lies between consecutive zeros, the formula becomes 1-b_n=2eta/(pi*n)-2eta^2*log(n)/(pi^2*n^2)+O(n^-2), proving both displayed limits. Fixed L>=0, eta>0; eta->0 and joint limits intentionally excluded.
